_about: plexscratch (PMS 1.43.4.10903), cycle 87 B2, 2026-10-02: python-plexapi's merge() shape (mixins/split_merge.py:19, PUT /library/metadata/{a}/merge?ids={b}) against plain movie collections. 'solo': collection B2 Solo over Tears of Steel (4, 2012) alone, 4 merged into Cosmos Laundromat (18, 2015, not a member). 'pair': B2 Pair over Elephants Dream (17, 2006) and Cosmos Laundromat (18), 17 merged into 18. Each read set is taken before the merge, at once after it and 20 s later. 'follow': on B2 Pair after its merge, its last member 18 removed, then 3 (Sintel, 2010) added, then 18 re-added. 'delete': the media-item DELETE the copy refuses (allowMediaDeletion true, media mount read-only), so a collection emptied by a row DELETE is unmeasurable here. Token and machine identifier redacted; /:/prefs reduced to its two deletion settings. The scratch copy was reset afterwards. Movie rows are trimmed to ratingKey, key, type, title, year, Collection and their Media ids; collection rows are as served.

Setting.label: Allow media deletion
Setting.summary: The owner of the server will be allowed to delete media files from disk.
